description: KG schema for GeneRec verdict repository — schema-based entity + relationship extraction

Verdict.description: An evaluation/decision document for a specific task, recorded in verdicts/task<N>_*.md

Issue.description: A GitHub issue tracking a research direction, ablation, or bug

Task.description: A concrete execution unit, identified by task_id, usually maps to one stage or one experiment

Hypothesis.description: A testable claim, e.g. 'κ-Stereographic formula improves R@10'

Method.description: An algorithm/technique being tested, e.g. HypPreEncoder, per-layer Codebook Transforms

Hyperparameter.description: A specific tunable value with concrete setting (e.g. c=0.74, radius_list=[0.1,1.0,10.0])

Metric.description: An evaluation metric, e.g. Recall@10, NDCG@20

RootCause.description: Identified mechanism that explains a NO-GO outcome (e.g. mode collapse, Sinkhorn-train/inference gap)

Decision.description: A binary or graded decision point: GO / NO-GO / NEUTRAL, with rationale

Stage.description: A pipeline stage (Stage 1 RQ-VAE, Stage 2 Sinkhorn, Stage 3 T5-mini, Stage 4 R@K eval)

Gate.description: A pass/fail checkpoint in a multi-stage experiment (Gate 0 sandbox → Gate 1 train → Gate 2 infer → Gate 3 T5 → Gate 4 eval)

Verdict--evaluates-->Issue.description: The verdict evaluates/tests the issue's claim

Verdict--evaluates-->Task.description: The verdict evaluates the task's outcome

Verdict--tests-->Hypothesis.description: The verdict provides evidence for/against a hypothesis

Verdict--supersedes-->Verdict.description: This verdict supersedes (corrects/extends/replaces) an earlier verdict

Verdict--identifies-->RootCause.description: This verdict identifies this root cause as the mechanism for the outcome

Verdict--achieves-->Metric.description: The verdict records a measured value for this metric

Verdict--executes-->Stage.description: The verdict executes/is associated with this stage

Verdict--passes-->Gate.description: The verdict passes this gate (or fails, with decision=NO-GO)

Task--executes-->Stage.description: The task is part of this stage

Task--tests-->Issue.description: The task is part of resolving/testing this issue

Task--configures-->Hyperparameter.description: The task uses this hyperparameter setting

Method--variant_of-->Method.description: This method is a variant of a parent method

Method--cites-->Paper.description: This method references/foundations on this paper

Method--uses-->Hyperparameter.description: This method has this hyperparameter as part of its design

Issue--depends_on-->Issue.description: This issue depends on / is joint with another issue

Hypothesis--refuted_by-->Verdict.description: This verdict provides refutation evidence for this hypothesis

Hypothesis--confirmed_by-->Verdict.description: This verdict provides confirmation evidence for this hypothesis

RootCause--mitigated_by-->Method.description: This root cause was attempted to be mitigated by this method

Decision--alternative-->Decision.description: Two decisions are alternative options in an R11.5 trade-off

Stage--precedes-->Stage.description: This stage must complete before the next

Gate--gates-->Stage.description: This gate is a checkpoint for this stage
